hints.title: Precompute Collinear Point Sets
hints.text: For every pair of points, compute the bitmask of all points lying on the line connecting them.

hints.title: Bitmask Dynamic Programming
hints.text: Let dp[mask] be the minimum number of lines needed to cover the subset of points represented by mask.

hints.title: Pick First Uncovered Point
hints.text: At each state, focus on the first uncovered point and transition by choosing any precomputed line covering that point.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unconstrained backtracking without bitmask pruning repeats subset computations factorially.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputing lines takes O(N^3) time; bitmask DP takes O(2^N * N) time with O(2^N) memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Cross multiplication to avoid float slopes and bitmask DP transitions.
